headline: EPS falls sequentially but rises year-over-year
summary_short: PT Antam (Persero) reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of Rp124.08, down 12.5% q/q from Rp141.77 but up 16.2% y/y from Rp106.74.
summary_long: EPS of Rp124.08 fell 12.5% sequentially from Rp141.77 and rose 16.2% year-over-year from Rp106.74. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. No edgarCik and no filing-kind sourceLink; antam.com press release returned HTTP 403 (blocks datacenter IPs) and two WebSearches surfaced only a Q1 2026 IDX-filed PDF plus a third-party (mining.com.au) synthesized figure for H1 2026 net sales/profit that could not be independently verified against a primary document, so it is omitted here.
